utility.notes: Moraga is a well-documented Contra Costa County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: MCE (Marin Clean Energy)
value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms Moraga as one of 16 Contra Costa County communities it serves (alongside Concord, Danville, El Cerrito, Hercules, Lafayette, Martinez, Oakley, Pinole, Pittsburg, Pleasant Hill, Richmond, San Pablo, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, and unincorporated Contra Costa County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

permit_authority.notes: The Town of Moraga's own FAQ directly confirms building permits are issued by Contra Costa County; the Town's own Planning Department only reviews non-exempt projects (e.g., ground-mounted or commercial solar).

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value.name: Manufacturer's specification sheets and installation instructions

required_documents.notes: Contra Costa County's own SolarAPP+ page explicitly lists the Town of Moraga among the jurisdictions covered by this process (Unincorporated County, Clayton, Hercules, Lafayette, Orinda, and the Town of Moraga).

value: Call 925-646-4108 to schedule inspection with the automated phone system, and schedule the '120 Building-Final' inspection
Same-day inspections via the automated phone system are accepted until 5:30 AM Monday-Friday; requests left on voicemail will not be scheduled
Inspections can also be scheduled online by searching for the permit number

value.notes: Contra Costa County's own SolarAPP+ page (which explicitly covers the Town of Moraga) states 'The permit will be auto-issued and emailed to you in a few minutes' after submitting the SolarAPP+-approved application and paying fees, and that eligible projects use 'the automated SolarAPP+ portal for instant permitting.'

value.program_or_pathway: Contra Costa County building permit (Moraga contracts building services to the County)
other_conditions: Residential roof-mounted solar panels are exempt from Town design review but require a Contra Costa County building permit
Non-exempt solar projects (commercial installations, new ground-mounted racks) must be reviewed by the Town Planning Department and may be subject to design review and approval
